as_told.title: Oberth's 1954 lecture on UFOs watching nuclear sites

plain: In a 1954 lecture, the German rocket pioneer Hermann Oberth is said to have argued that UFOs were real craft. The researcher Kevin Knuth tells Michels he has Oberth's own lecture notes. He says that in them Oberth "mentions that he saw numerous radar measurements of their speeds up to 19 km per second." Knuth also links Oberth to Wernher von Braun. Michels describes the same lecture himself in an episode about NASA, drawing on the same notes but stressing different points. He says Oberth argued "these UFOs had been observed since at least the 1400s" and believed they were "piloted by extraterrestrial visitors monitoring Earth's nuclear sites and military tech." If true, one of the founders of rocketry would have believed, in the 1950s, that alien craft were watching Earth.
